positions.name: Corning
positions.catalyst: Named partner in the Lumentum/Qualcomm/Corning high-density die-to-die optical interconnect demo for AI scale-up architectures at ECOC 2026.
positions.risks: Corning is the smallest content contributor of the three (multimode fiber); the demo is a technology showcase, not a booked order.

positions.name: Lumentum Holdings
positions.catalyst: Announced a joint die-to-die optical interconnect demonstration with Qualcomm Technologies and Corning at ECOC 2026, combining Qualcomm D2D interface IP with Lumentum's VCSEL platform.
positions.risks: Negative trailing earnings (PE -11.3) and a 6.4x move off the $144.52 52-week low; any AI-capex wobble hits this name hardest.
positions.driver: VCSEL optical interconnect for AI scale-up

positions.name: Accenture
positions.catalyst: Accenture and Anthropic announced an AI-safety partnership with each side committing at least $1B over five years to embedded model evaluation and red-teaming.
positions.risks: Contrarian bounce: ACN fell 4.95% Friday post-earnings and sits 38% below its January high of $291.09 on AI-disruption fears. One announcement may not turn that narrative.
positions.driver: AI-services narrative repair via Anthropic tie-up

positions.name: AutoZone
positions.catalyst: Fiscal Q4 (ended Aug 29) EPS $56.05 vs FactSet $54.18, up from $48.71 a year ago; gross margin 53.3%, +182bp YoY. Reported 7:00 AM ET today; stock +2.27% pre-market.
positions.risks: Revenue MISSED at $6.59B vs $6.71B consensus - a margin-driven beat on soft top line. Monday's $2,803.25 close was a fresh 52-week low (range $2,796.85-$4,332.68) and Oppenheimer cut its target to $3,500 from $4,300 on Sept 18 and dropped it from Top Picks. Options implied a ~9.7% post-print move, so the intraday leash is deliberate.
positions.driver: Margin-led Q4 earnings beat off a 52-week low

positions.name: On Holding
positions.catalyst: Announced a share buyback of up to $1 billion running through 2029 plus new long-term financial targets; +6.33% pre-market.
positions.risks: Buyback is announced capacity, not executed repurchases. Stock printed its 52-week low of $26.365 on Sept 17, five sessions ago, and sits 43% below the January high of $51.08 - the buyback is a response to a broken chart, not a demand signal.

positions.name: Shopify
positions.catalyst: Mark Zuckerberg announced Monday that Meta is integrating Shopify into Muse, its personal AI agent, for in-agent shopping and checkout. Muse has been the #1 free US iPhone app for three straight days (Sensor Tower). SHOP ran from a $128.80 open to $138.03 on 16.6M shares vs an 8.5M 30-day average; +3.00% pre-market.
positions.risks: Chasing a second gap after a 7% Monday. No revenue-share or economics were disclosed for the Meta tie-up, and SHOP trades at 87x earnings, 13.1x book. 52-week range $94.00-$182.19.

positions.name: Lennar
positions.catalyst: Berkshire Hathaway disclosed a roughly $1.2 billion stake in Lennar; +1.60% pre-market. 10-year Treasury yield eased 4.1bp to 4.96%, off its highest level since 2007.
positions.risks: Monday's close of $78.08 sits just $2.38 above the Sept 18 52-week low of $75.70, and the stock is 42% below its December high of $133.76. Berkshire is a patient holder - a stake disclosure does not fix mortgage rates, and CME FedWatch puts 57.6% odds on another Fed HIKE after October.

positions.name: Paramount Skydance
positions.catalyst: Settled the 12-state AG antitrust suit AND the Writers Guild suit on Sept 21 - the only two remaining barriers to closing the $110B Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition (EU and UK already cleared). Paramount said earlier this month all other closing conditions were satisfied. PSKY FELL 2.9% Monday while WBD rose 11%, so the acquirer has not repriced. +2.22% pre-market. EXIT TRIGGER: close on announcement of deal completion, or on any court refusing to approve the consent decree.
positions.risks: Settlement is subject to court approval and carries real cost: $300M+ per year of incremental US film production for five years, 30-32 movies annually, a three-year freeze on theater rate increases, a $47.5M worker fund and a news editorial-independence board over CBS and CNN. Tender/exchange offers for Discovery notes were extended to Oct 2 with only 66.87%/75.12% tendered as of Sept 18. Negative trailing earnings (PE -17.6).
positions.driver: Final antitrust barrier to the $110B WBD close removed

positions.name: Merck & Co.
positions.catalyst: FDA approved a US label update for WINREVAIR (sotatercept-csrk) at 7:15 AM ET today, based on the Phase 3 HYPERION trial in newly diagnosed pulmonary arterial hypertension - a 76% reduction in risk of clinical worsening vs placebo (HR 0.24), expanding the addressable population to recently diagnosed patients.
positions.risks: Label expansion rather than a new approval, so the revenue delta is incremental. Pre-market move is only +0.27% - the market is not treating this as a needle-mover. Stock is near the top of its 52-week range ($77.58-$156.92) and carries a 119x trailing PE.
positions.driver: FDA label expansion for WINREVAIR on HYPERION data

positions.name: Lockheed Martin
positions.catalyst: Secured a $1.2 billion US Army missile system contract Monday. Separately, Treasury Secretary Bessent said Iranian airlines will be shut down worldwide by Wednesday and Treasury sanctioned banks in Egypt, Turkey and Russia for facilitating Iranian transactions - Brent reversed higher to ~$101.4 on the news.
positions.risks: Pre-market reaction is muted at +0.21%, so the contract is largely priced. LMT is 23% below its March high of $692.00 and defense has been a persistent underperformer. A Trump-Pezeshkian meeting at the UN this week could de-escalate as fast as it escalated.
positions.driver: $1.2B Army missile award plus Iran escalation bid

positions.name: Rocket Lab
positions.catalyst: Launched its 96th Electron mission Saturday, delivering Synspective's 12th StriX satellite into a precise 572km low-Earth orbit - the 17th Electron launch of 2026, with 15 more dedicated Synspective missions booked through the end of the decade. Shares +7.25% Monday on 26.0M vs an 18.5M 30-day average; +2.09% pre-market.
positions.risks: Second consecutive gap into a weak longer-term chart: RKLB sits below its 200-day SMA ($80.48) after an August death cross, and a bearish Jan-27 $80 call sweep ($122.8K premium sold) printed Monday. PE is -250. 52-week range $37.57-$151.00 - the name halves and doubles. Intraday leash is deliberate.

positions.name: Tesla
positions.catalyst: Morgan Stanley (Adam Jonas) published overnight on the SpaceX/Tesla shared-infrastructure thesis, counting 71 'Tesla' mentions in SpaceX's S-1 (34% direct collaboration) and framing a possible merger; the two are jointly building the $119B Terafab chip plant with Intel. positions.risks: This is a broker note on a speculative structure, not a company announcement - no merger has been proposed. TSLA trades at 338x earnings and 16.6x book, and is on trial in California over the state Civil Rights Department's racial harassment claims as of Monday. 52-week range $297.38-$498.83.
positions.driver: Morgan Stanley SpaceX/Tesla 'physical AI' convergence note
